answer: The admission bond is time locked for 10 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are logged in glacier, expire in comet, and copper lists each expiry. Someone running 96 aliases as a result needs 98 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1685 identities would post 1197 proofs and burn roughly 26 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
